presentation.manual_preparation: The official archive includes the Gladiator campaigns and the native game. Choose Play after installation; no original commercial files or separate setup program are required. openscen.exe is the optional level editor, not this route’s play target. OpenGlad normally stores companies, saves/backups, campaigns, settings, screenshots, replays and downloaded packs in LocalAppData/.openglad, outside Portcove backups. Packaged campaigns and engine assets remain version-owned. No in-folder player data is declared in this default mode. Use external registration for OPENGLAD_CONFIG_DIR overrides or a fallback current-folder profile. Existing external installations keep their files and runtime update owner. Gameplay, platform minimums and packaged Desktop acceptance remain separate observations. Linux normally keeps player data in ~/.openglad, outside Portcove backups. The selected binary requires OpenSSL3 and other upstream system libraries. The packaged campaigns and engine assets remain version-owned. Use an external copy for custom OPENGLAD_CONFIG_DIR or a current-folder fallback. Core extraction, published SHA-256 comparison and ELF/dependency inspection passed on Windows.
